title: Lines containing a word
prompt: This program is run as a command: the input is a pair of the command-line arguments and the whole standard input text. The first argument is a pattern (if there are no arguments, the pattern is empty). Output every line of the standard input that contains the pattern as a contiguous substring, in order, each followed by a newline. Lines are separated by '\n'; a final line without a trailing newline still counts as a line, but there is no extra empty line after a trailing newline.
